clips.title: 迪士尼高管回应裁员：结构调整持续，过程极其艰难

subtitles.en: So you guys announced some cuts earlier this week.
subtitles.zh: 你们本周早些时候宣布了一些裁员。

subtitles.en: Everyone is sort of waiting for there to be another restructuring at some point.
subtitles.zh: 大家都在等着什么时候会有新一轮重组。

subtitles.en: I mean, going back to, I don't remember if it was after Bob came, but I feel like over the last three or four years, every six months you guys are cutting people restructuring.
subtitles.zh: 我是说，回想起来，我不记得是不是在鲍勃来之后，但我觉得过去三四年里，你们每半年都在裁员重组。

subtitles.en: I think that's probably an exaggeration.
subtitles.zh: 我觉得这可能是夸张了。

subtitles.en: All, but it's not just Disney. It happened at Warner Brothers Discovery.
subtitles.zh: 但不只是迪士尼。华纳兄弟探索也发生过。

subtitles.en: It happened at Paramount. I'm just wondering how are there still people to fire and how is there still restructuring when you have fired thousands of people?
subtitles.zh: 派拉蒙也发生过。我只是想知道，怎么还有人可以裁，裁了成千上万人怎么还有重组？

subtitles.en: So wow, the snarkiest possible version of this question.
subtitles.zh: 哇，这是这个问题最讽刺的版本了。

subtitles.en: I would start with we're not firing people every six months.
subtitles.zh: 我想先说，我们并不是每半年就裁人。
en_highlights: not firing people every six months

subtitles.en: I think like all of our similarly situated competitors and certainly all of our competitors in the tech
subtitles.zh: 我认为，像所有处境相似的竞争对手，当然还有我们在科技行业的所有竞争对手一样，

subtitles.en: industry, there is a need to constantly evaluate how you're structured, you know,
subtitles.zh: 需要不断评估自己的结构，你知道，

subtitles.en: what, how big is the organization?
Disney, you know, along with core Disney is a series of amazing acquisitions.
subtitles.zh: 迪士尼，你知道，除了核心业务，还有一系列令人惊叹的收购。

subtitles.en: And a number of them, I'll just speak for the Fox teams that came over.
subtitles.zh: 其中一些，我就说说福克斯团队过来的情况。
